title: fifteen minutes from an injected clock, expiring at the boundary, never resurrected
production_seam: yes — NarralensHost.impactClock is a dependency, not a call to Date.now()
tests: tests/wave2/m4a/impact-store.test.ts::expires exactly at the boundary, from the injected clock alone
tests/wave2/m4a/impact-store.test.ts::marks an expired row expired rather than leaving it active with a past deadline

notes: The boundary is `now >= expires_at`. A replay one millisecond early returns the identical spec and identical expiry; at the deadline the same key returns 428 and the row's state is corrected to expired, so a later reader does not see an active row with a past deadline.
